en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2490 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission
that the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) saw a camel tied up with its gear still on it.
Prophet (sw) said: "Where is its owner? Tell him to prepare for a dispute tomorrow (on the Day of Judgment)."
